tenets.title: Knowledge Graphs for decision-making and provenance with AI
tenets.question: How can a knowledge graph organise information so that AI-assisted decisions carry their provenance — every answer traceable to evidence, every uncertain extraction kept out of the canonical graph until it is curated?

projects.name: Research.AI
projects.goal: Show that a curated, provenance-bearing research graph gives better-grounded answers than an LLM's own recall.
projects.status: Staging on Cloud Run; approaching the experimental comparison against LLM-generated graphs.
projects.note: inferred — confirm: agentic-kg + the Denario integration (plan §11).

projects.name: Construction.AI
projects.goal: A material take-off whose every quantity is traceable to a drawing element and whose simulation inputs carry quantified uncertainty.
projects.status: Phase 1 MVP on Cloud Run; Phase 5 adds a VVUQ layer for engineering-simulation reproducibility.

tenets.title: Agentic software engineering
tenets.question: What agentic development has actually built versus what it has measured, and how to govern agents so their output is reviewable, reproducible and honest?

projects.name: State of the Art in Agentic Software Engineering
projects.goal: A defensible map of the field and a memory-evaluation method.
projects.status: Two research tracks published as digests on this site; the survey is private until publication.

projects.name: Agentic governance and agentic research
projects.goal: Make governed, reproducible agent work the default rather than the exception.
projects.status: Active; the Springer chapter proposal "Governed Agentic Research" is due 2026-10-23.

projects.name: AI-aware application architecture
projects.goal: A three-layer hybrid: a deterministic skeleton, adaptive agent-driven decision points, and a shared capability substrate.
projects.status: Design work, not yet a repository — listed as a thread, not a project.
projects.note: Plan §11 lists this as a thread unless the owner wants it shown.

tenets.title: AI safety
